# xterm.js, vendored

The demo drawer's terminal (`../../demo.js`). Inlined into the deck by the dev
server, so a preview needs no network.

| file | from | version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `xterm.js`, `xterm.css` | npm `@xterm/xterm` (`lib/`, `css/`) | 5.5.0 |
| `addon-fit.js` | npm `@xterm/addon-fit` (`lib/`) | 0.10.0 |

Both MIT: `LICENSE` and `LICENSE.addon-fit`. The files are as published; to
update, replace them from the new packages and change the table.
